newFindings.title: Authenticated organisation profile writes must acquire the stronger initial org lock, avoiding shared-to-exclusive upgrades
newFindings.scope: Server-selected organisationWrite lock mode; no current-authority check removed.

newFindings.title: Policy read locking must not require granting runtime policy-edit authority
newFindings.notes: SELECT FOR SHARE required UPDATE; replaced by tenant-bound narrow locking read function, keeping ordinary policy UPDATE denied.

newFindings.title: Single-project offers need durable project scope before new consumption
newFindings.notes: ONE_TIME_PROJECT new consumption remains unavailable until a complete scoped offer model and approved policy exist. It is not automatically excluded from required product scope.

newFindings.title: Scheduled upload expiry deletes retained version identities and does not distinguish provider cleanup
newFindings.notes: Expiry now retains FAILED/ABORTED tombstones, existing latest-version references and explicit unconfirmed cleanup state. Physical provider cleanup is not claimed.

newFindings.title: Authenticated guest mutations can upgrade a shared project lock during live authority revalidation
newFindings.notes: Server selects initial write lock mode before live authority checks. Two independently authenticated guest upload-intent transactions complete without shared-lock upgrade.

newFindings.title: RA evidence-pack generation bypasses monthly entitlement and lifecycle gates
newFindings.notes: Both package routes share project and capacity gates; RA route requires transport idempotency. Tests deny absent/zero/month-exhausted/closed cases and verify failed creation rolls back reservation.

newFindings.title: Package build owners need distinct attempt fencing and abandoned-lease recovery
newFindings.notes: Unique per-invocation ownership fences reservation/publication/terminal failure; retryable failures release to QUEUED. Busy BullMQ jobs delay until completion or DB-clock lease expiry. Recovered attempts allocate distinct object keys and preserve cleanup tombstones. Actual compiler/PG fixture and old-behavior mutation verified; real provider cleanup, Redis delivery acceptance, exact-head CI and independent review remain pending.
